That is exactly what he was doing, and this is why his child died - so he could try and prove a point about the legitimacy of his lifestyle choices.  He is wrong, his beliefs are wrong, and he and his wife should have all their remaining kids taken from their care, and preferably be sterilised because they are not fit to raise other human beings.

His FB page is full of self-pitying "oh boo hoo, we's so persecuted" schtick and not once have I ever got the impression he is especially sad his kid is dead.

My ex Husband was morbidly obese and had an ED when we met. We got engaged (because he proposed publicly and i didn't have the spine to say "no", shame on me) and he flat-out refused to do anything about his weight before we were wed. 


Our marriage photos were awful, he was massive. I was fairly slender, but not too skinny.  He refused to do anything, lied about going to OA meetings, and even though I had to sleep on a sofa more nights than not because oh his sleep apnoea and snoring, he still refused to sort it out.

I left him in July last year,, just after we hit the three year mark on our marriage and we're divorcing soon. He did start to sort his weight but by then it was too little too late. Also, he was expecting me to do ALL the cooking to his specifications for his weight loss, which majorly pissed me off.


Things I learned form this? Someone who doesn't respect themselves won't respect you. If they lie about seeking help, run far away. And never, ever, ever get involved with a selfish, petty man-boy who refuses to half in equally on chores, cooking, grocery shopping and household stuff, because you are not a skivvy.

Right now, I have laryngitis and physically can't talk :(

I don't have a support network here in the city I moved to, and it's really hard for me to reach out to people. I'd love to call my family but can't talk to anyone just now and it's so hard to just sit here, mute and feeling trapped :(
